Title: Clarification Mary the Black & Lillith's Blessing (2 seperate questions)

Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi
Just wonder about these two cards.

Nr1

Mary the Black
Clan: Baali (group 2)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: DAI PRE cel obf pot
Independent: Once each round, Mary may burn a blood to make the damage
from her hand strikes aggravated for the current round. Infernal.

Q: Now "Once each round" does that mean once each round of combat, or
once each round of play (from Meth A to E). I guess each round of
Combat

Nr. 2

Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card
to search your library for a Master : Discipline card and choose a
ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire
gains
the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.

Q: Do you have to find a master: Discipline card? And if you ain't got
any more discipline cards can you use it? If I use LB on Mary, but I
only have Presence cards in my deck, what happens? I hope you don't
have to find a Master.

Messages.Author: LSJ
